description: This file contains an implementation of the AES (Rijndael) cipher, including key setup, encryption, and decryption functions, with optimizations and support for 128-bit keys. It also includes preprocessor options for size and performance trade-offs.

methods.name: rijndaelKeySetupEnc
methods.description: Expands the cipher key into the encryption key schedule for AES.

methods.name: rijndaelKeySetupDec
methods.description: Expands the cipher key into the decryption key schedule for AES.

methods.name: rijndaelEncrypt
methods.description: Performs AES encryption on a 16-byte plaintext block using the expanded key schedule.

methods.name: rijndaelDecrypt
methods.description: Performs AES decryption on a 16-byte ciphertext block using the expanded key schedule.
